definitions.exact_unique_utterance_count: number of distinct utterance strings (case- and punctuation-sensitive) in the whole CSV
definitions.pct_turns_with_repeated_exact_utterance: share of ALL turns whose exact utterance string occurs more than once anywhere in the CSV (the headline 58.5% figure for v1)
definitions.pct_long_turns_with_repeated_exact_utter: same, restricted to turns of >=12 words
definitions.normalized_utterance: lower-cased; client/advisor first names -> <name>; month-day dates -> <date>; $amounts and digits -> #; punctuation removed; whitespace collapsed
definitions.pct_turns_with_repeated_normalized_utter: share of turns whose NORMALISED string occurs more than once; always >= the exact figure; catches template lines that differ only by name, date or number
definitions.semantic_uniqueness: NOT COMPUTED. Embedding-based measures are out of scope for this phase; no semantic claim is made.
definitions.substantive_unique_turn: turn of >=15 words whose exact string occurs exactly once in the corpus (a proxy for hand-authored or state-specific content)
definitions.meetings_with_no_substantive_new_informa: meetings with fewer than 4 substantive unique turns. A proxy only: it can mislabel a short but important scripted meeting, and cannot see meaning
definitions.meetings_without_scripted_outcome_author: meetings whose authoring manifest records no decision, plan, tentative idea, deferral, correction or action item. Authoring-side metadata, not derived from the text

manual_review.statement: Manual review is qualitative and was performed by reading transcripts, not by keyword matching. It was done by the assistant that made the revision, so it is not an independent review. A human research reviewer should spot-check the entries marked adequate or still_thin.

rating_scale.substantive: contains client reasoning, advisor follow-up questions and a decision, an explicit uncertainty, a correction, or new information with a stated outcome
rating_scale.adequate: contains real content and a clear outcome, but mostly an advisor explanation with little client reasoning
rating_scale.still_thin: largely a recap or routine review; added content is short and has no logged outcome

relative dates that contradicted the real gap between meetings (born last week after a meeting two days earlier; stock vested last week; spoke on Tuesday after a Friday meeting) replaced by explicit dates or accurate wording
v1 timeline error: Grace's 'first investing step' meetings were dated before the plan's start month; the first step is now 1 June and the second 1 July
stale holdings text (Lucas still discussed crypto after selling it; Kenji's employer shares; Grace's 'inherited' account after the rollover)

a padding segment (generic market commentary) was being appended to short meetings, producing the same market conversation in three consecutive meetings for one client; padding now uses portfolio, cash-flow or a circumstances check, and none on a first meeting
'Moving on. Before we move on', 'Let me bring up liquidity' after a transition, '?.' and '..' punctuation, lowercased proper names in topic phrases
